title: Legacy Edition PvP Pack
description: This texture pack aims to brings back that old Nostalgic Legacy Console Edition Textures from those old Xbox 360 and PS3 days. It has been refined to include essential pvp textures like small totems, low fire, low shield, etc.
body:
Missing the old Legacy Console Edition Texture packs from the Xbox 360 and PS3 days?
This Pack aims to let people use those old textures once again.

This pack includes many pvp essentials + more like small totem and totem pop, low shield, low fire, etc. (View Gallery for visuals)

(NOTE: PACK IS STILL IN PROGRESS SO SOME TEXTURES MAY BE BROKEN OR UNAVAILABLE ATM, ALSO CURRENTLY ONLY SUPPORTS 1.21.11 BUT WILL CHANGE)
